raw_segments.text: So she took rather a fancy to fat, slow, little missent, John, and kept glancing toward her
She saw that lessons were no easy matter to her, and that there was no danger of her ever
being spoiled by being treated as a show pupil.
Her French lesson was a pathetic thing.
Her pronunciation made even Monsieur Dufarge smile in spite of himself, and La Vinnya and
Jessie and the more fortunate girls either giggled or looked at her in wondering disdain.
She tried to look as if she did not hear when Missent John called, Le Bon Pain, Lee Bong
She had a fine, hot little temper of her own, and it made her feel rather savage when she
heard the titters and saw the poor, stupid, distressed child's face.
